=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:364-365,595-602 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The P6 return-code contract for `unprocessed_docs` contradicts itself: line 364 says return 0 means a complete scan, but step 3 also returns 0 when the candidate cap stops the scan with candidates unexamined, and it lists the marker-cap stop under "return 0" before assigning it code 3.
  WHY: An implementer could make candidate-cap stops return 3, or misclassify capped scans as complete, and `promote_main_cycle.sh` would then act wrongly. Severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 said MAJOR, and the other three reviewers said NIT. The highest is used.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:391-394 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The stated comments-read bound ("plus one comments read for each doc whose search matched") understates the cost: `doc_dispatched_before` (scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:243-259) calls `trusted_marker_comment_present` once per matching issue, up to 20 per doc (per_page=20).
  WHY: The worst case is up to 20 comment reads per doc, or about 460 at the documented caps, so a figure copied into the README or a test would under-budget the API calls.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:367-368 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The plan returns exit code 3 from `unprocessed_docs`, but the caller runs `docs_output="$(unprocessed_docs)"`.
  WHY: The reviewer states that command substitution captures only stdout, so the caller would not receive code 3 and the capped-state handling would never trigger. The source gave no severity, so high is inferred.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:372-376 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Both existing callers (scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:405-410 and 448-453) treat any nonzero return as `guard_unavailable`, so return code 3 works only if both callers change.
  WHY: The plan's step 3 already says "Update both callers", so the reviewer says no action is needed.
- (external check copilot-pull-request-reviewer, run 42613939601) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The check fails with `Prompt too big after adding system message` (`custom_instructions_too_large`, HTTP 422) because AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md exceed the prompt limit.
  WHY: The check exits during request creation before it reads any diff, and no hunk in this PR causes it, so it is out of scope.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:364; 595-601 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The return-code contract contradicts itself. "Return 0 still means a complete scan", but step 3 also returns 0 on a candidate-cap stop with candidates unexamined, and it lists the marker-cap stop under "return 0" before returning 3 for it.
  WHY: An implementer could return 3 on a candidate-cap stop, which would print `capped_behind_markers=true` on every run with more than 3 unprocessed docs, so `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh` would skip with `scan_capped_behind_markers`.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:391-392 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The comments-read bound is too low. `doc_dispatched_before` (scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:237-261) uses per_page=20 and calls `trusted_marker_comment_present` per returned issue.
  WHY: The worst case is up to 20 comment reads per doc, not 1.
- docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md:372-376 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Both callers (scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh:405-410, 448-453) treat any nonzero return as `guard_unavailable`, so return code 3 needs both callers changed.
  WHY: The plan already says "Update both callers", so no action is needed.
- (external check copilot-pull-request-reviewer, run 42613939601) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The check fails with `Prompt too big after adding system message` (`custom_instructions_too_large`, 422), caused by loading AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
  WHY: It exits before reading any diff, so it is out of scope. Confidence was 4 that the failure is real and 1 that this diff caused it.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "each independently mergeable and each with its own rollback switch" (PR description)
  Expected change site: docs/plans/analysis-findings-collection-hardening-plan.md, "Phases & Merge Strategy" and "Rollout"
  Evidence of absence: Lines 435-439 say P2 must merge after P1 and P3. The rollback table at lines 464-469 lists `revert` for P3, P5 and P6, and lines 744-745 show only P1, P2 and P4 have switches. The plan is consistent, so only the PR description is inaccurate. SEVERITY: NIT, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
